subject: Pre-launch sitrep: roadmap status, critical dependencies & escalation asks
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Ellis <tim.ellis@orionretail.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@integration-partner.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-launch sitrep: roadmap status, critical dependencies & escalation asks

Team —

We're 3 weeks out from the Orion pilot launch and I want a concise, shared picture of where product + eng stand against the timeline, plus any items that require leadership escalation now. I attached the latest timeline and a simple risk registry (prod-roadmap-timeline.xlsx, risk-registry.csv). High-level concerns I want surfaced: 

1) Payments integration: partner (Marta) reports intermittent token expiry causing order retries — this directly affects go/no-go for payments-onboarding.
2) Model throughput at P95: current infra estimates show latency spikes at sustained 2.5k rps (simulated).
3) E2E test flakiness across the checkout flow — we need deterministic gating criteria for staging.

Please reply with a short status (Ready / At-risk / Blocked), owner, mitigation, and concrete ask for leadership if you mark At-risk or Blocked. If you need an explicit time window for follow-up, propose one.

Expectations: one-line per item, then a single consolidated follow-up from me by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & Strategy
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: prod-roadmap-timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet), risk-registry.csv (csv)

Date: Tue, 18 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-launch sitrep: roadmap status, critical dependencies & escalation asks

Vivek — thanks for the prompt. Short status below (feature / status / owner / mitigation / leadership ask):

- Checkout promotions (Ready) / Owner: Lauren Bishop. UI and promo rules validated on staging; no blocker.
- Payments onboarding (At-risk) / Owner: Monica Patel. Marta's team and our payments infra team identified token expiration race. Mitigation: temporary token refresh proxy to absorb expiry (ETA 48hrs). Leadership ask: brief signoff to run proxy in staging and allow the pilot to proceed with manual monitoring.
- Personalization ranking (At-risk) / Owner: Karthik Iyer. Model latency causing occasional rank inversion on long queries. Mitigation: reduce context window for first-pass ranking; fallback to simpler heuristic under high latency. Leadership ask: approve temporary heuristic fallback for pilot (metric degradation tolerable at <=5% CTR drop).
- A/B measurement hooks (Ready) / Owner: Product Analytics. Instrumentation complete.

I'll coordinate a short call with Marta/Tim to confirm the payments proxy details.

Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success & Launchs
Redwood Inference

Vivek / Monica — engineering update: short bullets.

- Throughput (At-risk) / Owner: Eng Infra (Karthik). Root cause: token refresh retries plus sudden KV cache misses cause bursty tail latency. We've reproduced at ~2.3k rps on a mixed workload.
  Mitigation plan (short term): enable per-tenant connection pooling + add a 5-node burst pool for the Orion pilot (can be provisioned within 24hrs if leadership approves additional reserved capacity).
  Ask: approve up to one week of burst capacity at dedicated pricing for pilot (we'll backfill).
  Related: JIRA JIRA-ENG-5942 (throughput investigation).

- Canary plan for model rollout: propose a staged ramp with 5% -> 20% -> 100% traffic windows and synthetic load testing between ramps. See attached canary-plan.pdf.

- E2E test flakiness: two flaky tests correlate to async job completion timing; temporary tweak is to increase polling timeout and add idempotency checks. Long-term: need a deterministic job-status fanout.

I'll be available for a short ops sync 11:00am tomorrow if that helps.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Engineering, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Quick prioritization note from product POV before we escalate to execs: 

If we need to shrink scope to preserve timeline, propose the following non-blocking deprioritizations for the pilot (ranked):
1) Extended personalization variants (defer to post-pilot).
2) Cross-account saved carts (defer; customers can use native cart + Redwood session).
3) Advanced promo stacking rules (keep simple stacking rules for pilot).

Tradeoff rationale: minimize surface area touching payments path and model ranking while maintaining the core checkout + personalization experience. If leadership approves temporary heuristic fallback (Monica/Karthik ask), we avoid blocking changes to the UI.

Action: if approved, I'll prepare a trimmed scope commit and update the release notes.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Group Product Manager, Growth
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — consolidating decisions and next steps: 

Decisions / Approvals: 
- Approve temporary payments token refresh proxy in staging for the pilot. Monica to coordinate with Marta for deployment; timeline: 48hrs. Leadership signoff granted.
- Approve temporary heuristic fallback for personalization up to a 5% CTR regression. Karthik to implement and validate via the canary plan.
- Approve one-week burst capacity for infra to absorb tail latency during pilot (finance will reconcile dedicated pricing). Karthik to spin up; Monica to notify Tim.

Action items (owner / due):
- Monica: deploy payment refresh proxy in staging and run end-to-end test with Marta (due: 2028-04-20 10:00 PDT).
- Karthik: implement fallback heuristic, run canary (JIRA-ENG-5942) and provide throughput baseline after burst nodes are live (due: 2028-04-21 11:00 PDT). Attach canary-plan.pdf.
- Lauren: produce trimmed-scope README and updated release notes for pilot (due: 2028-04-20 17:00 PDT).
- Vivek: schedule 30min exec sync Friday 09:00 PDT to ratify pilot go/no-go boundaries; invite list will be: Eng Infra, Product, CS, Ops, Finance.

I'll prepare a short one-page ticket for the exec sync summarizing the ask and the residual risks (will share via Drive link). If anything changes materially before tomorrow morning, flag in this thread.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & Strategy
